We received the packet this morning (invitation + passports + sponsor docs). Status update: 

- Standard processing estimate: 7–10 business days from submission (we'll aim for Aug 18 decision).

Next steps we will take: create consulate application drafts, verify names/passport numbers against the invite, and confirm earliest appointment slots. We'll update this thread with tracking once submitted.
